name: hud_ui_net_game_setup_prev_world_button
description: HudUiNetGameSetupPanel_PrevWorldButton::OnActivate rewinds the world selector, applies world-selection side effects, and runs base ZRD activation.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte comparison is covered by hud_ui_net_game_setup_world_buttons and passed after restoring the local world-selection side-effect body.
The smoke patches selector, visibility, input update, refresh, invalidate, and activation methods to isolate the button-side behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41a9c0 validates decrementing worldSelector.selectedIndex through SetIndexClamped, toggling kills/laps visibility, clamping kills to at least 2 on the laps path, enabling or disabling time-limit step buttons, invalidating affected controls, and then calling HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.
The native smoke verifies both the selectedIndex == 2 laps path and the non-laps path, including call targets and modeOrEnabled side effects.
